amdahl_counterfactuals.note: upper bounds for a strictly sequential topology; NOT forecasts

timer_semantics.collection_seconds: train_sync.run_iteration: from the call into run_batched() until it returns. Includes server creation/start, snapshot load into the inference child, initial reset, every ENCODE/STEP round trip and its wait, native step/reset, transition materialisation and sink put.
timer_semantics.update_seconds: train_sync.run_iteration: from after cohort build until the PPO updater returns. Includes frozen critic construction + state load, per-row V_old build_observation/encode/value/.item, GAE, advantage normalisation, per-microbatch row rebuild, ragged stacking, batched trainable encoder, per-row evaluate_encoded, backward, clip, Adam.
timer_semantics.checkpoint_seconds: torch.save of the full state, fsync, sha256, atomic rename, pointer publication and the policy snapshot write.
timer_semantics.wall_seconds: per-iteration perf_counter span covering collection + update + checkpoint + in-iteration residual (cohort assembly, publish).
